questions.q: Project 18A, approved by the Defence Acquisition Council, is a programme for:
questions.explanation: A **₹80,000-crore destroyer** programme with ~75% indigenous content.

questions.q: Gross GST collection in October 2026 was:
questions.explanation: **₹2.31 lakh crore**, up 23%.

questions.q: The 2027-28 Union Budget allocated how much to the Department of Space?
questions.explanation: **₹17,000 crore**, up from ₹13,705.6 crore.

questions.q: India's installed solar capacity has grown from 2.8 GW in 2014 to about:
questions.explanation: About **171 GW**; target 500 GW non-fossil capacity by 2030.

questions.q: Bhutan dedicated Chorten No. 76 of its 108 stupas to:
questions.explanation: To **PM Narendra Modi**, as part of the Gelephu Mindfulness City project.

questions.q: National Unity Day (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas) is observed on:
questions.explanation: **31 October**, Sardar Patel's birth anniversary (151st in 2026).

questions.q: The motto adopted by the new IAF chief Ashutosh Dixit is:
questions.explanation: **Nabha Sparsham Deeptam** (also the IAF's motto), with the 'VAYU' framework.

questions.q: Whom did Ashutosh Dixit succeed as Chief of the Air Staff?
questions.explanation: **A.P. Singh**, who retired after 43 years.

questions.q: Which city did Amit Shah say will be India's first drug-free city?
questions.explanation: **Chandigarh**, with a 93% conviction rate in NDPS cases.

questions.q: EPFO celebrated which Foundation Day in 2026?
questions.explanation: The **74th**; corpus over ₹32 lakh crore.

questions.q: Who won the 97th MCC-Murugappa Gold Cup hockey title?
questions.explanation: **Indian Navy**, beating BPCL 5-4 in a shootout.

questions.q: P.V. Sindhu and Lakshya Sen won singles titles at the Hylo Open Super 500, held in:
questions.explanation: **Saarbrücken, Germany**.

questions.q: Who became the highest run-scorer in a bilateral T20I series (341 runs vs India)?
questions.explanation: **Glenn Phillips**, passing Phil Salt's 331.

questions.q: India won the 2026 T20I series in New Zealand by what margin?
questions.explanation: **3-2**; captain Shreyas Iyer's first series win in a SENA country.

questions.q: The inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship was held in:
questions.explanation: **Ahmedabad**; India won both the men's and women's titles.

questions.q: According to PLFS, India's unemployment rate fell from 6.1% in 2017-18 to what in 2023-24?
questions.explanation: **3.2%**, though the Decent Work Index rose only from 0.247 to 0.302.

questions.q: The UNGA has passed a resolution against the US embargo on Cuba every year since:
questions.explanation: Since **1992**. India voted in favour again.

questions.q: The RBI's inflation-targeting band for CPI inflation is:
The long-period average (LPA) of India's southwest monsoon rainfall is about:
questions.explanation: About **87 cm**; 2026 ended nearly 13% below it.

questions.q: The Lyngdoh Committee (2006) is associated with rules for:
questions.explanation: **Student union elections** in colleges and universities.
